flavors.fr: Le lanceur fait les gros yeux à l’ennemi pour l’intimider et baisser sa Défense.
flavors.es: Intimida a los rivales para bajar su Defensa.

name: bite
effect: Tem chance de fazer o alvo recuar.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
flavor: O alvo é mordido com presas extremamente afiadas. Isso também pode fazer o alvo recuar.

flavors.en: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
flavors.fr: L’ennemi est mordu par de tranchantes canines. Peut l’apeurer.
flavors.es: Un voraz bocado que puede amedrentar al objetivo.

name: growl
effect: Diminui o Ataque do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
flavor: O usuário rosna de um jeito fofo, deixando os Pokémon adversários menos atentos. Isso diminui o Ataque deles.

flavors.en: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur pousse un cri tout mimi pour tromper la vigilance de l’ennemi et baisser son Attaque.
flavors.es: Dulce gruñido que reduce el Ataque del equipo rival.

name: roar
effect: Encerra na hora batalhas contra Pokémon selvagens. Obriga treinadores a trocar de Pokémon.
effect_full: Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately. Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.
flavor: O alvo é assustado e outro Pokémon é puxado para a batalha. Na natureza, encerra a batalha contra um único Pokémon.

flavors.en: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
flavors.fr: Effraie le Pokémon ennemi et le remplace par un autre. Lors d’un combat contre un Pokémon sauvage seul, met fin au combat.
flavors.es: Se lleva al objetivo, que es cambiado por otro Pokémon. Si es un Pokémon salvaje, acaba el combate.

name: sing
effect: Faz o alvo dormir.
effect_full: Puts the target to sleep.
flavor: Uma canção de ninar tranquila é cantada com uma voz linda que faz o alvo dormir.

flavors.en: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.
flavors.fr: Une berceuse plonge l’ennemi dans un profond sommeil.
flavors.es: Cancioncilla que hace dormir profundamente al objetivo.

name: supersonic
effect: Deixa o alvo confuso.
effect_full: Confuses the target.
flavor: O usuário produz ondas sonoras estranhas pelo corpo que deixam o alvo confuso.

flavors.en: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur produit d’étranges ondes sonores qui rendent la cible confuse.
flavors.es: Raras ondas sónicas que confunden al objetivo.

name: sonic-boom
effect: Causa 20 pontos de dano.
effect_full: Inflicts exactly 20 damage.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: disable
effect: Desativa o último golpe usado pelo alvo por 1 a 8 turnos.
effect_full: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.
flavor: Por quatro turnos, o alvo não consegue usar o último golpe que usou.

flavors.en: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
flavors.fr: Empêche l’ennemi d’employer à nouveau sa dernière attaque. Dure quatre tours.
flavors.es: Desactiva el último movimiento del objetivo durante cuatro turnos.

name: acid
effect: Tem chance de diminuir a Defesa Especial do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: Os Pokémon adversários são atacados com um jato de ácido forte. Isso também pode diminuir a Defesa Especial deles.

flavors.en: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur attaque l’ennemi avec un jet d’acide corrosif. Peut aussi baisser sa Défense Spéciale.
flavors.es: Rocía a los enemigos con un ácido corrosivo. Puede bajar la Defensa Especial.

name: ember
effect: Tem chance de queimar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor: O alvo é atacado com pequenas chamas. Isso também pode deixar o alvo com queimadura.

flavors.en: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flavors.fr: L’ennemi est attaqué par une faible flamme. Peut aussi le brûler.
flavors.es: Ataca con llamas pequeñas que pueden causar quemaduras.

name: flamethrower
effect: Tem chance de queimar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.
flavor: O alvo é queimado com uma rajada intensa de fogo. Isso também pode deixar o alvo com queimadura.

flavors.en: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flavors.fr: L’ennemi reçoit un torrent de flammes. Peut aussi le brûler.
flavors.es: Ataca con una gran ráfaga de fuego que puede causar quemaduras.

name: mist
effect: Protege os atributos do usuário de serem alterados por golpes inimigos.
effect_full: Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns. Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.
flavor: O usuário cobre a si e aos aliados com uma névoa branca que impede que qualquer atributo seja diminuído por cinco turnos.

flavors.en: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.
flavors.fr: Une brume blanche enveloppe l’équipe du lanceur et empêche la réduction des stats pour cinq tours.
flavors.es: Rodea de fina niebla al usuario y protege las características de su equipo durante cinco turnos.

name: water-gun
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: O alvo é atingido por um jato forte de água.

flavors.en: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
flavors.fr: De l’eau est projetée avec force sur l’ennemi.
flavors.es: Ataca disparando agua con gran potencia.

name: hydro-pump
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: O alvo é atingido por um enorme volume de água lançado sob alta pressão.

flavors.en: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
flavors.fr: Un puissant jet d’eau est dirigé sur l’ennemi.
flavors.es: Lanza una gran masa de agua a presión para atacar.

name: surf
effect: Causa dano normal e pode acertar quem está usando Dive.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.
flavor: O usuário ataca tudo ao redor inundando a área com uma onda gigante.

flavors.en: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
flavors.fr: Une énorme vague s’abat sur le champ de bataille et inflige des dégâts à tous les Pokémon autour du lanceur.
flavors.es: Inunda el terreno de combate con una ola gigante.

name: ice-beam
effect: Tem chance de congelar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.
flavor: O alvo é atingido por um raio de energia gelado. Isso também pode deixar o alvo congelado.

flavors.en: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
flavors.fr: Un rayon de glace frappe l’ennemi. Peut aussi le geler.
flavors.es: Rayo de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.

name: blizzard
effect: Tem chance de congelar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.
flavor: Uma nevasca uivante é invocada para atingir os Pokémon adversários. Isso também pode deixar os adversários congelados.

flavors.en: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
flavors.fr: Une violente tempête de neige s’abat sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi le geler.
flavors.es: Tormenta de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.

name: psybeam
effect: Tem chance de deixar o alvo confuso.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.
flavor: O alvo é atacado com um raio peculiar. Isso também pode deixar o alvo confuso.

flavors.en: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.
flavors.fr: Un étrange rayon frappe l’ennemi. Peut aussi le rendre confus.
flavors.es: Extraño rayo que puede causar confusión.

name: bubble-beam
effect: Tem chance de diminuir a Velocidade do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
flavor: Um jato de bolhas é disparado com força no alvo. Isso também pode diminuir a Velocidade do alvo.

flavors.en: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
flavors.fr: Des bulles sont envoyées avec puissance sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi baisser sa Vitesse.
flavors.es: Diluvio de burbujas que puede bajar la Velocidad.

name: aurora-beam
effect: Tem chance de diminuir o Ataque do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
flavor: O alvo é atingido por um raio colorido como o arco-íris. Isso também pode diminuir o Ataque do alvo.

flavors.en: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
flavors.fr: Envoie un rayon arc-en-ciel sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi baisser son Attaque.
flavors.es: Rayo multicolor que puede reducir el Ataque.

name: hyper-beam
effect: O usuário perde o turno seguinte para recarregar.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
flavor: O alvo é atacado com um raio poderoso. O usuário não pode se mover no turno seguinte.

flavors.en: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
flavors.fr: Projette un puissant rayon sur l’ennemi. Le lanceur doit se reposer au tour suivant.
flavors.es: Es eficaz, pero el atacante deberá descansar en el siguiente turno.

name: peck
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: O alvo é espetado com um bico ou chifre pontudo para causar dano.

flavors.en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.
flavors.fr: Frappe l’ennemi d’un bec pointu ou d’une corne pour infliger des dégâts.
flavors.es: Ensarta al objetivo con un cuerno o pico punzante.

name: drill-peck
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: Um ataque em espiral que atinge o alvo com um bico afiado que funciona como broca.

flavors.en: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.
flavors.fr: Une attaque utilisant le bec comme une perceuse.
flavors.es: Picotazo giratorio y perforador muy potente.

name: submission
effect: O usuário recebe 1/4 do dano causado como recuo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
flavor: O usuário agarra o alvo e mergulha de qualquer jeito em direção ao chão. Isso também causa um pouco de dano ao usuário.

flavors.en: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur agrippe l’ennemi et l’écrase au sol. Blesse aussi légèrement le lanceur.
flavors.es: El usuario se lanza al suelo con el oponente en brazos y también se hace un poco de daño.

name: low-kick
effect: Causa mais dano em alvos mais pesados, com poder máximo de 120.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120
flavor: Um chute baixo poderoso que derruba o alvo. Quanto mais pesado o alvo, maior o poder do golpe.

flavors.en: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
flavors.fr: Un puissant coup de pied bas qui fauche l’ennemi. Il est plus efficace contre les ennemis lourds.
flavors.es: Patada baja que derriba al oponente. Cuanto más pesa el objetivo, más daño le causa.

name: counter
effect: Causa o dobro do dano que o usuário recebeu do último golpe físico que levou.
effect_full: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.
flavor: Um ataque de revide que responde a qualquer golpe físico, causando o dobro do dano recebido.

flavors.en: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
flavors.fr: Une riposte qui répond à toute capacité physique en infligeant le double de dégâts.
flavors.es: Devuelve un golpe físico por duplicado.

name: seismic-toss
effect: Causa dano igual ao nível do usuário.
effect_full: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.
flavor: O alvo é arremessado usando a força da gravidade. Causa dano igual ao nível do usuário.

flavors.en: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
flavors.fr: L’ennemi est projeté grâce au pouvoir de la gravité. Inflige des dégâts équivalents au niveau du lanceur.
flavors.es: Aprovecha la gravedad para derribar al objetivo. Le resta tantos PS como nivel tenga el usuario.

name: strength
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: O alvo leva um soco dado com força máxima.

flavors.en: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur cogne l’ennemi de toutes ses forces.
flavors.es: Propina un potente puñetazo con todas sus fuerzas.

name: absorb
effect: Drena metade do dano causado para curar o usuário.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
flavor: Um ataque que drena nutrientes. O PS do usuário é recuperado em até metade do dano recebido pelo alvo.

flavors.en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
flavors.fr: Une attaque qui convertit la moitié des dégâts infligés en PV pour le lanceur.
flavors.es: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.

name: mega-drain
effect: Drena metade do dano causado para curar o usuário.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
flavor: Um ataque que drena nutrientes. O PS do usuário é recuperado em até metade do dano recebido pelo alvo.

flavors.en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
flavors.fr: Une attaque qui convertit la moitié des dégâts infligés en PV pour le lanceur.
flavors.es: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.

name: leech-seed
effect: Planta sementes no alvo, roubando PS dele a cada turno.
effect_full: Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field. The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze. Rapid Spin will remove this effect. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
flavor: Uma semente é plantada no alvo. Ela rouba um pouco de PS do alvo a cada turno.

flavors.en: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
flavors.fr: Une graine est semée sur l’ennemi. À chaque tour, elle lui dérobe des PV que le lanceur récupère.
flavors.es: Planta semillas que absorben PS del objetivo en cada turno y que le sirven para recuperarse.

name: growth
effect: Aumenta o Ataque e o Ataque Especial do usuário em um estágio.
effect_full: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. During Sunny Day, raises both stats by two stages.
flavor: O corpo do usuário cresce de uma vez, aumentando o Ataque e o Ataque Especial.

flavors.en: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
flavors.fr: Le corps du lanceur se développe. Augmente l’Attaque et l’Attaque Spéciale.
flavors.es: Hace que su cuerpo crezca a marchas forzadas con lo que aumenta su Ataque y Ataque Especial.

name: razor-leaf
effect: Tem chance maior de golpe crítico.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
flavor: Folhas afiadas são lançadas para cortar os Pokémon adversários. Este golpe tem chance maior de acerto crítico.

flavors.en: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
flavors.fr: Des feuilles aiguisées comme des rasoirs entaillent l’ennemi. Taux de critiques élevé.
flavors.es: Corta con hojas afiladas. Un ataque que suele ser crítico.

name: solar-beam
effect: Precisa de um turno para carregar antes de atacar.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
flavor: O usuário junta luz no primeiro turno e dispara um raio concentrado no turno seguinte.

flavors.en: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
flavors.fr: Absorbe la lumière au premier tour et envoie un rayon puissant au tour suivant.
flavors.es: El usuario absorbe luz en el primer turno y en el segundo lanza un potente rayo de energía.

name: poison-powder
effect: Envenena o alvo.
effect_full: Poisons the target.
flavor: O usuário espalha uma nuvem de pó venenoso que envenena o alvo.

flavors.en: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.
flavors.fr: Une poudre toxique empoisonne l’ennemi.
flavors.es: Polvo tóxico que envenena al objetivo.

name: stun-spore
effect: Paralisa o alvo.
effect_full: Paralyzes the target.
flavor: O usuário espalha uma nuvem de pó entorpecente que paralisa o alvo.

flavors.en: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur répand sur l’ennemi une poudre qui le paralyse.
flavors.es: Esparce polvo que paraliza al objetivo.

name: sleep-powder
effect: Faz o alvo dormir.
effect_full: Puts the target to sleep.
flavor: O usuário espalha uma nuvem de pó sonífero que faz o alvo dormir.

flavors.en: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur répand une poudre soporifique qui endort la cible.
flavors.es: Esparce polvo que duerme al objetivo.

name: petal-dance
effect: Ataca todo turno por 2 a 3 turnos e depois deixa o usuário confuso.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.
flavor: O usuário ataca o alvo espalhando pétalas por dois a três turnos. Depois o usuário fica confuso.

flavors.en: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur attaque en projetant des pétales pendant deux à trois tours avant de céder à la confusion.
flavors.es: Lanza pétalos de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al atacante.

name: string-shot
effect: Diminui a Velocidade do alvo em dois estágios.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
flavor: O usuário sopra seda pela boca que prende os Pokémon adversários e diminui muito a Velocidade deles.

flavors.en: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur crache de la soie pour ligoter l’ennemi et beaucoup baisser sa Vitesse.
flavors.es: Lanza seda a los rivales y reduce mucho su Velocidad.

name: dragon-rage
effect: Causa 40 pontos de dano.
effect_full: Inflicts exactly 40 damage.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: fire-spin
effect: Impede o alvo de fugir e causa dano por 2 a 5 turnos.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.
flavor: O usuário prende o alvo num redemoinho feroz de fogo que causa dano por quatro a cinco turnos.

flavors.en: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
flavors.fr: Un tourbillon de flammes emprisonne l’ennemi pendant quatre à cinq tours.
flavors.es: Un aro de fuego que atrapa al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos.

name: thunder-shock
effect: Tem chance de paralisar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: O usuário ataca o alvo com uma descarga elétrica. Isso também pode deixar o alvo paralisado.

flavors.en: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavors.fr: Une décharge électrique tombe sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi le paralyser.
flavors.es: Ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.

name: thunderbolt
effect: Tem chance de paralisar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: O usuário ataca o alvo com uma forte rajada elétrica. Isso também pode deixar o alvo paralisado.

flavors.en: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavors.fr: Une grosse décharge électrique tombe sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi le paralyser.
flavors.es: Potente ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.

name: thunder-wave
effect: Paralisa o alvo.
effect_full: Paralyzes the target.
flavor: O usuário lança uma descarga elétrica fraca que paralisa o alvo.

flavors.en: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
flavors.fr: Un faible choc électrique frappe l’ennemi. Si l’attaque le touche, celui-ci est paralysé.
flavors.es: Una ligera descarga que paraliza al objetivo si lo alcanza.

name: thunder
effect: Tem chance de paralisar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.
flavor: Um raio terrível cai sobre o alvo para causar dano. Isso também pode deixar o alvo paralisado.

flavors.en: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavors.fr: La foudre tombe sur l’ennemi pour lui infliger des dégâts. Peut aussi le paralyser.
flavors.es: Un poderoso rayo que daña al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.

name: rock-throw

name: substitute
effect: Transfere 1/4 do PS máximo do usuário para um boneco, que protege o usuário de dano e mudanças de status até quebrar.
effect_full: Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
flavor: Este golpe permite ao usuário se proteger de todos os ataques. A chance de falhar aumenta se for usado em sequência.

flavors.en: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur se protège de toutes les attaques. Peut échouer si utilisée plusieurs fois de suite.
flavors.es: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.

name: bone-rush
effect: Acerta de 2 a 5 vezes num turno.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.
flavor: O usuário ataca golpeando o alvo com um osso duro. Este golpe acerta de duas a cinco vezes seguidas.

flavors.en: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur frappe l’ennemi avec un os de deux à cinq fois d’affilée.
flavors.es: Hueso en ristre, aporrea al objetivo de dos a cinco veces.

name: lock-on
effect: Garante que o próximo golpe do usuário acerte o alvo.
effect_full: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.
flavor: O usuário mira com precisão no alvo. Isso garante que o próximo golpe do usuário não erre esse alvo.

flavors.en: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.
flavors.fr: Verrouille l’ennemi pour ne pas le rater au tour suivant.
flavors.es: Fija el blanco para que el siguiente ataque no falle.

name: outrage
effect: Ataca todo turno por 2 a 3 turnos e depois deixa o usuário confuso.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.
flavor: O usuário fica furioso e ataca por dois a três turnos. Depois o usuário fica confuso.

flavors.en: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur enrage et attaque pendant deux ou trois tours avant de devenir confus.
flavors.es: Ataca de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al agresor.

name: sandstorm
effect: Muda o clima para tempestade de areia por cinco turnos.
effect_full: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.
flavor: Uma tempestade de areia de cinco turnos é invocada e causa dano a todos os Pokémon, menos os dos tipos Pedra, Terra e Aço. A tempestade também aumenta a Defesa Especial dos Pokémon do tipo Pedra.

flavors.en: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.
flavors.fr: Une tempête de sable blesse tous les Pokémon pendant cinq tours, sauf ceux de type Roche, Sol ou Acier. Augmente la Défense Spéciale des Pokémon Roche.
flavors.es: Tormenta de arena que dura cinco turnos y hiere a todos, excepto a los de tipo Roca, Tierra y Acero, y aumenta la Defensa Especial de los de tipo Roca.

name: giga-drain
effect: Drena metade do dano causado para curar o usuário.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
flavor: Um ataque que drena nutrientes. O PS do usuário é recuperado em até metade do dano recebido pelo alvo.

flavors.en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
flavors.fr: Une attaque qui convertit la moitié des dégâts infligés en PV pour le lanceur.
flavors.es: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.

name: endure
effect: Impede que o PS do usuário caia abaixo de 1 neste turno.
effect_full: The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
flavor: O usuário aguenta qualquer ataque ficando com pelo menos 1 de PS. A chance de falhar aumenta se for usado em sequência.

flavors.en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur résiste aux attaques avec 1 PV. Peut échouer si utilisée plusieurs fois de suite.
flavors.es: Resiste cualquier ataque y deja al menos 1 PS. Puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.

name: charm
effect: Diminui o Ataque do alvo em dois estágios.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
flavor: O usuário olha para o alvo de um jeito encantador, deixando-o menos atento. Isso diminui muito o Ataque do alvo.

flavors.en: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur fait les yeux doux pour berner l’ennemi et beaucoup réduire son Attaque.
flavors.es: Engatusa al objetivo y reduce mucho su Ataque.

name: rollout
effect: O poder dobra a cada turno em que o golpe é usado em sequência depois do primeiro, voltando ao normal depois de cinco turnos.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.
flavor: O usuário rola sem parar contra o alvo por cinco turnos. O ataque fica mais forte a cada acerto.

flavors.en: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.
flavors.fr: Un rocher roule sur l’ennemi pendant cinq tours. L’attaque gagne en puissance à chaque coup.
flavors.es: El atacante rueda contra el objetivo durante cinco turnos, cada vez con mayor fuerza.

name: false-swipe
effect: Não consegue deixar o PS do alvo abaixo de 1.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.
flavor: Um ataque contido que impede o alvo de desmaiar. O alvo fica com pelo menos 1 de PS.

flavors.en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur retient ses coups pour que l’ennemi garde au moins 1 PV et ne tombe pas K.O.
flavors.es: Ataque moderado que no debilita al objetivo y le deja al menos 1 PS.

name: swagger
effect: Aumenta o Ataque do alvo em dois estágios e o deixa confuso.
effect_full: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.
flavor: O usuário enfurece e confunde o alvo. Mas isso também aumenta muito o Ataque do alvo.

flavors.en: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
flavors.fr: Fait enrager la cible et la plonge dans la confusion, mais augmente beaucoup son Attaque.
flavors.es: Provoca confusión en el objetivo, pero también sube mucho su Ataque.

name: milk-drink
effect: Cura o usuário em metade do PS máximo.
effect_full: Heals the user for half its max HP.
flavor: O usuário recupera até metade do próprio PS máximo.

flavors.en: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur récupère jusqu’à la moitié de ses PV max.
flavors.es: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario.

name: spark
effect: Tem chance de paralisar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: O usuário ataca o alvo com uma investida carregada de eletricidade. Isso também pode deixar o alvo paralisado.

flavors.en: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavors.fr: Lance une charge électrique sur l’ennemi. Peut aussi le paralyser.
flavors.es: Ataque eléctrico que puede llegar a paralizar.

name: fury-cutter
effect: O poder dobra a cada turno em que o golpe é usado em sequência depois do primeiro, chegando ao máximo depois de cinco turnos.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.
flavor: O usuário ataca cortando o alvo com foices, garras ou algo parecido. O ataque fica mais forte se acertar em sequência.

flavors.en: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
flavors.fr: Un coup de faux ou de griffe dont la force augmente quand il touche plusieurs fois d’affilée.
flavors.es: Ataque con garras o guadaña que crece en intensidad si se usa repetidas veces.

name: steel-wing
effect: Tem chance de aumentar a Defesa do usuário em um estágio.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.
flavor: O alvo é atingido por asas de aço. Isso também pode aumentar a Defesa do usuário.

flavors.en: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur frappe l’ennemi avec des ailes d’acier. Peut aussi augmenter la Défense du lanceur.
flavors.es: Alas macizas que golpean al objetivo y pueden subir la Defensa del usuario.

name: mean-look
effect: Impede o alvo de sair da batalha.
effect_full: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.
flavor: O usuário prende o alvo com um olhar sombrio e paralisante. O alvo não consegue mais fugir.

flavors.en: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur pétrifie l’ennemi en lui lançant un regard noir. Il devient incapable de s’enfuir.
flavors.es: Mal de ojo que impide al objetivo huir del combate.

name: attract
effect: O alvo se apaixona se for do gênero oposto e tem 50% de chance de se recusar a atacar o usuário.
effect_full: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.
flavor: Se o alvo for do gênero oposto ao do usuário, fica apaixonado e às vezes não consegue usar seus golpes.

flavors.en: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
flavors.fr: Si l’ennemi est du sexe opposé, il tombe amoureux et rechigne alors à attaquer.
flavors.es: Si el objetivo es del sexo opuesto, se enamorará y bajará la posibilidad de que ataque.

name: sleep-talk
effect: Usa aleatoriamente um dos outros três golpes do usuário. Só funciona se o usuário estiver dormindo.
effect_full: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP. This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar. If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
flavor: O usuário usa aleatoriamente um dos golpes que conhece. Este golpe só pode ser usado enquanto o usuário estiver dormindo.

flavors.en: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur utilise une de ses capacités au hasard pendant qu’il dort.
flavors.es: Mientras duerme, usa uno de sus movimientos elegido al azar.

name: heal-bell
effect: Cura toda a equipe dos principais problemas de status.
effect_full: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.
flavor: O usuário toca um sino calmante que cura os problemas de status de todos os Pokémon da equipe e aliados.

flavors.en: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
flavors.fr: Carillon apaisant qui soigne les altérations de statut de tous les Pokémon de l’équipe.
flavors.es: Tañido que cura los problemas de estado de todos los Pokémon del equipo.

name: return
effect: O poder aumenta com a felicidade, até o máximo de 102.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: present
effect: Causa dano aleatório com poder de 40 a 120 ou cura o alvo em 1/4 do PS máximo.
effect_full: Randomly uses one of the following effects. Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20% On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.
flavor: O usuário ataca dando ao alvo um presente com uma armadilha escondida. Mas às vezes o presente recupera PS.

flavors.en: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur attaque en offrant un cadeau piégé à la cible. Peut cependant restaurer certains de ses PV.
flavors.es: Quien lo usa ataca al objetivo dándole un regalo con una bomba trampa. Sin embargo, a veces restaura sus PS.

name: frustration
effect: O poder aumenta conforme a felicidade diminui, até o máximo de 102.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: safeguard
effect: Protege o lado do usuário dos principais problemas de status e de confusão por cinco turnos.
effect_full: Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field. If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect. This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.
flavor: O usuário cria um campo protetor que impede problemas de status por cinco turnos.

flavors.en: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
flavors.fr: Crée un champ protecteur qui empêche toutes les altérations de statut pendant cinq tours.
flavors.es: Un escudo que protege de problemas de estado, como el sueño o la parálisis, durante cinco turnos.

name: pain-split
effect: Deixa o PS do usuário e do alvo iguais à média do PS atual dos dois.
effect_full: Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken. This effect fails against a Substitute.
flavor: O usuário soma o próprio PS ao PS do alvo e divide o total igualmente entre os dois.

flavors.en: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur ajoute ses PV à ceux de sa cible et les répartit équitablement.
flavors.es: Suma los PS del usuario a los del objetivo y los reparte a partes iguales.

name: sacred-fire
effect: Tem chance de queimar o alvo. Permite que Pokémon congelados se descongelem.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
flavor: O alvo é arrasado por um fogo místico muito intenso. Isso também pode deixar o alvo com queimadura.

flavors.en: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur génère un feu mystique d’une intensité redoutable pour attaquer l’ennemi. Peut aussi le brûler.
flavors.es: Fuego místico de gran intensidad que puede causar quemaduras.

name: magnitude
effect: O poder varia aleatoriamente de 10 a 150.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71: Magnitude | Power | Chance --------: | ----: | -----: 4 | 10 | 5% 5 | 30 | 10% 6 | 50 | 20% 7 | 70 | 30% 8 | 90 | 20% 9 | 110 | 10% 10 | 150 | 5% This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: dynamic-punch
effect: Tem chance de deixar o alvo confuso.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.
flavor: O usuário ataca socando o alvo com toda a força concentrada. Isso também deixa o alvo confuso.

flavors.en: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur rassemble ses forces et envoie un coup de poing à l’ennemi. Rend ce dernier confus.
flavors.es: Puñetazo con toda la fuerza concentrada. Causa confusión si atina.

name: megahorn
effect: Causa dano normal, sem efeito extra.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: Usando seu chifre duro e imponente, o usuário investe contra o alvo sem trégua.

flavors.en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur utilise ses gigantesques cornes pour charger l’ennemi.
flavors.es: Violenta embestida con cuernos imponentes.

name: dragon-breath
effect: Tem chance de paralisar o alvo.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: O usuário solta um sopro poderoso que causa dano. Isso também pode deixar o alvo paralisado.

flavors.en: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur souffle fort sur l’ennemi pour lui infliger des dégâts. Peut aussi le paralyser.
flavors.es: Poderosa ráfaga de aliento que golpea al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.

name: baton-pass
effect: Permite ao treinador trocar o usuário e passar os efeitos para o substituto.
effect_full: User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon. The following move effects are passed: * Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.
flavor: O usuário troca de lugar com um Pokémon da equipe que esteja esperando e passa para ele as mudanças de atributos.

flavors.en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
flavors.fr: Le lanceur échange sa place et tout changement de stat avec un Pokémon de l’équipe.
flavors.es: Cambia el puesto con otro miembro del equipo y le pasa los cambios de características.

name: encore
effect: Obriga o alvo a repetir o último golpe usado a cada turno, por 2 a 6 turnos.
effect_full: The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.
flavor: O usuário obriga o alvo a continuar usando o mesmo golpe por três turnos.

flavors.en: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
flavors.fr: Oblige l’ennemi à répéter la dernière capacité utilisée durant trois tours.
flavors.es: El objetivo repite su último movimiento durante tres turnos.

name: pursuit
effect: Tem o dobro de poder contra Pokémon tentando sair da batalha, e consegue acertá-los.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power. This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.
flavor: Este golpe não pode ser usado. É recomendado esquecê-lo. Depois de esquecido, não pode ser lembrado.

flavors.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavors.fr: Cette capacité ne peut pas être utilisée. Il est recommandé de l’oublier, même s’il sera impossible de se la remémorer une fois oubliée.
flavors.es: Este movimiento no se puede usar, por lo que sería mejor olvidarlo, aunque eso implique que no se pueda recordar posteriormente.

name: rapid-spin
effect: Livra o usuário de golpes que prendem, remove Leech Seed e sopra os Spikes para longe.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.
flavor: O usuário faz um ataque giratório que também elimina os efeitos de golpes como Bind, Wrap e Leech Seed. Isso também aumenta a Velocidade do usuário.

flavors.en: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
flavors.fr: Une attaque tournoyante pouvant aussi annuler, par exemple, Étreinte, Ligotage ou Vampigraine. Augmente également la Vitesse du lanceur.
flavors.es: Ataque giratorio que puede eliminar movimientos como Atadura, Constricción y Drenadoras. También aumenta la Velocidad del usuario.

name: sweet-scent
effect: Diminui a Evasão do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.
flavor: O usuário solta um aroma que diminui muito a Evasão dos Pokémon adversários.

flavors.en: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
flavors.fr: Un doux parfum qui réduit beaucoup l’Esquive de l’ennemi.
flavors.es: Un dulce aroma engatusa al objetivo, por lo que se reduce mucho su Evasión.

name: iron-tail
effect: Tem chance de diminuir a Defesa do alvo em um estágio.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
flavor: O alvo é golpeado com uma cauda dura como aço. Isso também pode diminuir a Defesa do alvo.

name: hidden-power
effect: O poder e o tipo dependem dos IVs do usuário. O poder vai de 30 a 70.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

name: future-sight

flavors.es: Libera de una vez la energía acumulada con Reserva. La potencia del ataque será proporcional a la cantidad de energía acumulada.

name: swallow

effect_full: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.
flavor: A força acumulada com o golpe Stockpile é absorvida pelo usuário para recuperar o próprio PS. Quanto mais força acumulada, mais PS recupera.

flavors.en: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.

flavors.es: Llama la atención para concentrar todos los ataques de todos los del equipo rival hacia sí mismo.

flavor: O alvo é provocado até ficar furioso e só consegue usar golpes de ataque por três turnos.

This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.
